- Review item 7's literal check ("build diff touches no file under `evidence/phase-4.5/build-evidence/`") fails on inspection; see the spec-deviation finding above for why I assess it as low rather than blocker.

F4 is a legitimate, well-disclosed widening: both corrected referents exist on disk, and re-rooting without the tail fix would have produced the §7 correctly-rooted-404 shape.
